the results of the initial investigation showed a difference in performance between the two production batches. It was also confirmed that the same battery type was used in both productions. As a quick corrective action, we reduced the CPU frequency and limited the maximum screen brightness. These adjustments improved battery performance by approximately 4 hours under heavy usage, as shown in the attached report.
